TS018 no-complex-macros

A macro stays small, because a reader cannot step through an expansion.

languages: rust
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable
go: Go has no macro system; go:generate runs a program rather than expanding text
javascript: JavaScript has no macro system; there is no expansion to weigh
odin: Odin has no macro system; a #directive instructs the compiler rather than expanding text
python: Python has no macro system; a decorator is an ordinary call, not an expansion
typescript: TypeScript has no macro system; there is no expansion to weigh
zig: Zig has comptime rather than a textual macro expander

NASA P10 Rule 8: "The use of the preprocessor must be limited to the inclusion of header files and simple macro definitions. Token pasting, variable argument lists (ellipses), and recursive macro calls are not allowed. All macros must expand into complete syntactic units."
